headline: Markets closed for weekend; FPI flows, crude oil, and global trends to steer upcoming holiday-shortened week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: FPI flows, crude oil movements, and global cues are expected to drive market direction in the upcoming holiday-shortened week.
A global sell-off in AI stocks weighed on broad market sentiment during recent trading sessions.
Record FII buying previously boosted Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs, extending a four-week rally.
Hawkish signals from the US Fed regarding interest rate hikes added to global market headwinds.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex fell around 250 points with Nifty dropping below 25,450 in early trade due to global tech sell-offs.
CCPA imposed a Rs 10-lakh penalty on a firm for listing an 'anti-drone gun' on IndiaMART.
ITC expanded its Braille-enabled packaging initiatives to its Fiama product range, bringing total SKUs to 16.
Adani Group expanded into West Bengal's power sector, prompting political calls for transparency.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November. In the last session, markets traded lower as global AI stock pullbacks outweighed recent record FII buying gains. Investors are looking ahead to crude oil trends, foreign inflows, and global cues to guide the holiday-shortened trading week.
